senses.gloss:
mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be fixed or determined.
2 To be placed.
m. (-यः)
1 A judge, an arbitrator, one who decides upon a dispute between two parties.
2 A domestic priest.
E.
ष्ठा to stand, यत् aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
1 Firm, stable, fixed.
2 Eternal, permanent.
E.
स्थिर firm, ईयसुन् aff. of the superlative, and स्था substituted for the adjective.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Firm, stable, fixed, durable.
E.
स्थिर firm, इष्ठन् aff., and स्था substituted for the primitive.
